events.what: Hegde, Sandeep, Shashank prove the Erdős–Gyárfás conjecture for P13-free graphs
Carr proves graphs of diameter 2 and minimum degree >=3 contain a cycle of length 4 or 8
Tranquilli: no cubic bipartite counterexample on fewer than 60 vertices, via certified exhaustive computation
events.ai_basis: OpenAI ChatGPT materially assisted the initial research, including developing computational and structural approaches, portions of the incidence-based code and preliminary arguments

events.what: Garcia: no minimum-degree-3 counterexample on fewer than 24 vertices, via SAT search with DRAT certificates
events.ai_basis: Computations were carried out with the assistance of an AI system (Claude); all results were independently re-verified

judgement.doubts: Minimal-counterexample order bounds amount to exhaustive checks of all graphs up to n vertices, so they are instances of a universal statement (F4), not bounds, and cannot set the status. The Garcia quote is thin: 'computations were carried out with the assistance of' does not clearly say the AI produced mathematics. Carr's paper is recorded as published 2026-01-30, so it counts as digested. It is an equally valid partial event, and both have AI role none. The bullet says 'cubic graphs', while the record uses the minimum-degree-3 form. Both case results are restrictions under either reading.

outcome_prefix: Judged: the status rests on Hegde, Sandeep and Shashank's proof of the conjecture for P13-free graphs (arXiv:2410.22842, first posted 2024-10-30), a case settlement; Carr's diameter-2 result is a second case.

corrections.why: F4/F8: the record says the P13-free and diameter-2 results are 'cases of the general conjecture' and gives them as the alternative in competing_reading. The minimal-counterexample order results are exhaustive checks up to n vertices (instances), not bounds. A case outranks everything else left.

F8: 'bound' is not an AI role code. The AI disclosures belong to the 2026 instance-check papers, not the event the status rests on. The record says the P13-free and diameter-2 papers have 'no AI disclosed'.
other: a partial status carries the chosen event's direction; the P13-free proof confirms the conjecture on that class.
F8: the status now rests on the P13-free case result, dated by its first posting as the record gives it.
